english:
Non-Exotic Rocket Launcher Kills within 5 seconds progress a counter, with progress based on <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] />:
• Rank-and-File: 25%
• Elites: 34%
• Minibosses: 100%

At 100% Counter Progress, Rocket Launchers gain 1 Ammo and 65 Reload Speed for 10 seconds. Precision and High-Impact Rocket Launchers, and Rocket Launchers with Bipod, gain 2 Ammo instead.

Scavenger mods do not affect it.

source.text:
Non-Exotic Rocket Launcher Kills within 5 seconds of each progress a counter.
Rank-and-File = 25% | Elite = 34% | Miniboss = 100%

Upon reaching 100% Counter Progress:
Rocket Launchers are granted +1 Ammo.
Precision/High-Impact Rockets (or Bipod RLs) receive +2 Ammo.
+65 Reload Speed for 10 seconds.
Not affected by Scavenger Mods.
